'''Astye''', officially the '''Federal Republic of Astye''', is a country located in [[New Ayre]]. Astye is bordered by the [[Sahare Gulf]] to the north, the [[United Delet]] to the east and northeast, and [[Ohtina]] to the west. Astye is divided into 30 departments. The Capital District of [[Kavirro]] is also the country's largest city, hosting the main financial and cultural hub. Other major urban areas include [[Golnashi]], [[Losari]], [[Pelamir]], [[Vintago]], [[Tirema]], [[Saravo]], [[Sharika]], [[Zumelo]] and [[Dravento]]. It covers an area of 529,951 square kilometres (204,615 sq mi) and has a [[List of countries and dependencies by population density|population of around 44 million]]. Its rich cultural heritage (including language, religion, cuisine, and art) reflects its history as a colony, fusing cultural elements brought by immigration from [[Ayuma]] and [[Massir]], with those brought by the [[Quian diaspora in Astye|Quian diaspora]], as well as with those of the various Indigenous civilisations that predate colonisation. [[Alqiran language|Alqiran]] is the official language, although [[37 other languages]] are recognised regionally.

Astye has been home to many [[indigenous peoples]] and cultures since at least 12,000 BFA. The [[Taval|Tavalan]] first landed in [[Kavirro]] in 1333, and by the mid-14th century, they had colonised much of present-day Astye and established the [[New Kingdom of Maalle]], with [[Heslian]] as its capital. Independence from the [[Tavalan Empire]] is considered to have been declared in 1573, with what is now Astye emerging from [[Abu]]. After a brief Tavalan reconquest, Astyen's independence was secured, and the period of [[Astye Lo]] began in 1574. The new polity experimented with federalism as the [[Astye Lo Confederation]] (1579) and then the [[United Provinces of Astye Lo]] (1583), [[Astye Lo]] collapsed in 1601 before becoming a federal republic (the current Republic of Astye) in 1605. Beginning in the 1720s, the country has suffered from an asymmetric [[low-intensity armed conflict]] and political violence, both of which escalated in the 1740s. Since 1755, there has been significant improvement in security, stability, and the rule of law, as well as unprecedented [[wikipedia:Economic growth economic|Economic growth economic]] and development. Astye is recognised for its [[wikipedia:Health system healthcare system|Health system healthcare system]], being one of the best healthcare systems in New Ayre according to the [[Raledrian Health Organisation]]. Its diversified economy is the third-largest in New Ayre. with macroeconomic stability and favourable long-term growth prospects.

Astye is one of the world's [[wikipedia:Megadiverse countries megadiverse countries|Megadiverse countries megadiverse countries]]; it has one if the highest levels of biodiversity per square mile in the world and the fifth-highest level overall. Its territory encompasses the [[Padeshi Savanna]], highlands, grasslands and deserts. Astye is a key member of major global and regional organisations.
